up: Retrieve the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL3436042. The output must include exactly these columns: canonical SMILES, ChEMBL ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Only include rows where the activity represents an exact measurement (standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL). Join activities with assays, filtering for assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3436042', and join compound_structures and molecule_dictionary to obtain the canonical SMILES and ChEMBL ID. Do not apply any row limits.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM assays ass
JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3436042'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
